description: This bar chart, titled "Average Performance" from the paper "Context-Informed Grounding Supervision," displays the average performance scores for five different methods: "Standard," "Self-RAG," "FactTune," "ClinGS (w/)," and "ClinGS." The vertical y-axis, labeled "Average Performance," ranges from 0 to 60 in increments of 10, with a linear scale and gridlines at each 10-unit interval. The horizontal x-axis lists the five methods in left-to-right order. Each method is represented by a single, solid-colored bar: "Standard" is orange, "Self-RAG" is beige, "FactTune" is light green, "ClinGS (w/)" is blue, and "ClinGS" is dark blue. The bars are ungrouped and unstacked, with each representing its respective method's performance. The approximate values are: "Standard" at 55, "Self-RAG" at 55, "FactTune" at 52, "ClinGS (w/)" at 55, and "ClinGS" at 60. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order listed on the x-axis. The chart does not include any shading, outlines, or annotations on the bars to emphasize specific data points.
